resources.string: This app is getting ready for your classroom. Hub connection and saved lessons will be available in a later update.
Your classes will appear here after account setup and connection to your classroom Hub are available.
L.A.R.A. brings lessons and classroom activities to your device. This version sets up the app; account setup and classroom features are coming later.
Ask your teacher for the address shown on the Hub computer.
Checking: Please wait while we reach your Hub.
Check the address: Copy the numbers and optional port from your teacher, such as 192.168.1.50:8080.
Hub unavailable: Check the address with your teacher and try again.
Hub responding: The download page is reachable. Account connection is coming in a later update.
Hub disconnected: Join your classroom Wi-Fi, or enter the Hub address below.
Discovery interrupted: You can still enter the Hub address or try scanning again.
No Hub found yet: Ask your teacher for the address or try again.
Hubs found: Choose your classroom Hub below.
This version finds Hubs and checks their download page. Classes and saved lessons arrive in later updates.
